Create three synthetic ContentWorkspace records through the data API, and query RootContentFolderId for each. Sort the first two root IDs and create a ContentFolder child under each. The third root is the null case. Re-query ParentContentFolderId of these three selected folders and identify records as N, L, H. At each API version query them with ORDER BY ParentContentFolderId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST.
